# 🎉 Sona 1.0 — Stable

Sona is officially stable and ready for everyday listening. After a long stretch of building, rebuilding and polishing, this is the release we have been working towards: a fast, beautiful, offline music player for the music that lives on your phone. Thank you for being here for it.

## What Sona is

Sona is a local music player for Android. No accounts, no streaming, no ads, no tracking — just your own library, organised the way you think about it, and a player that feels good to hold. It opens instantly, stays in sync with your files on its own, and gets out of the way so the music can take over.

## ✨ Highlights

- **Instant launch** — your library is on screen the moment the app opens, never an empty list that fills in later.
- **A living library** — new downloads and deleted files appear and disappear on their own, with no manual rescans.
- **A player built to be touched** — a swipeable bottom-sheet player with a cover carousel, a draggable queue and artwork-driven colours.
- **Synced lyrics** — line-by-line and word-by-word lyrics that scroll, glow and bounce in time with the song.
- **Playlists that are really yours** — create, reorder, import and export, with Favorites built in.
- **Updates inside the app** — new versions are found, downloaded and installed from within Sona.

## 📚 Your library

- Browse by **Tracks, Artists, Albums, Genres and Folders**, and hide the tabs you never use.
- **Search** every tab at once from the top bar, with results narrowing as you type.
- **Sort** any list by what matters to you, and Sona remembers it — each album, playlist or folder can keep its own order.
- **Intelligent sorting** that ignores "The" and "A" and orders numbers naturally.
- Detail screens for every album, artist, genre and folder, with a **collapsible header** and Play and Shuffle always within reach.
- **Recent** and **Most played** lists, built from your own listening.
- **Exclude folders** you never want to see, such as ringtones or voice notes.

## ✅ Select, act, share

- **Long-press to select** tracks, albums, artists and more — even across tabs — then act on them all at once.
- An **options sheet** on every row: play next, add to queue, add to a playlist, go to the artist or album, share, and more.
- **Share any number of tracks** instantly, without copying a single file.

## 🎶 Playlists

- Create, rename and delete playlists, or **build one straight from a folder**.
- **Drag tracks into your own order** and keep it, whatever sort the rest of the app uses.
- Add tracks one by one or whole albums, artists, genres and folders at once, with a clear count before anything is added.
- **Import and export M3U** playlists to move them between apps and devices.
- **Favorites** is a playlist of its own, one heart-tap away from the player and the notification.

## 🎧 The player

- A **mini player** that expands into a full player with a swipe, and a **queue** you can reorder by dragging.
- **Swipe the cover** to move between tracks, with smooth, reliable skip controls.
- See **what the queue is playing from** — an album, a playlist, a folder — and jump straight back to it.
- **Choose your player style** and your **seek bar style**, including a squiggly animated one.
- Colours drawn from the **playing track's artwork**, flowing across the whole app.

## ▶️ Playback

- **Repeat all, repeat one and stop after the current track**, plus shuffle.
- Tap the playing track to **pause or resume** instead of starting it over.
- **Rewind before skipping back**, the way a real player does.
- A **sleep timer** to fall asleep to your music.
- A **built-in equalizer** that remembers your sound.
- Your **queue is saved** and waiting where you left it, and a headset button brings the music back even with the app closed.
- A rich **media notification** with shuffle, repeat and a favorite toggle.

## 🎤 Lyrics

- Reads the **lyrics embedded in your files**, including synced LRC, TTML and QRC.
- **Word-by-word highlighting** with adjustable glow, bounce and fill smoothness.
- **Romanization** for Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi and more.
- Tune the text size, line spacing, blur and background to your taste.
- Lyrics for upcoming songs are **preloaded**, so they are ready the moment a track starts.

## 🎨 Look and feel

- **Material You** design with dynamic, artwork-driven colours and light and dark themes.
- **Edge-to-edge** screens with system bars that follow the theme.
- Beautiful **collection covers** composed from your tracks' artwork, in the style you prefer.
- An animated **launch screen** and a redesigned app icon.
- Consistent, calm dialogs and menus throughout, with tactile, expressive buttons.

## 🔄 Updates

- Sona checks for new versions on its own and tells you when one is ready.
- Downloads continue in the background with progress in the notification, and install in a tap.
- Prefer to stay in control? Turn the alerts off and check whenever you like from **Settings › Updates**.

## 📦 Getting started

- **Requirements:** Android 8.0 or newer.
- **Which file?** Download the **universal** APK if you are not sure — it runs on every device. The per-architecture APKs are smaller; most modern phones use **arm64-v8a**.
- On first launch, allow access to your music, and your library appears on its own.

## 💛 Thank you

Sona 1.0 is the start, not the finish. Thank you for trying it, using it and caring about it. Press play, and enjoy the music.
